snippets.GAME_INVITATION_ANSWER_01: Unfortunately the other panda can not play with you. Maybe another time!
snippets.GAME_INVITATION_ANSWER_02: The panda you invited does not wish to play this game right now. Maybe another time.

snippets.GAME_INVITATION_INFO_01: Do you want to select a panda and invite him/her for a game of $$gamename$$? If you click yes, a crosshair cursor will appear. Simply use it and click on your chosen panda. Then please stay in this room to play the game.

snippets.GAME_INVITATION_INFO_03: You have already invited another panda. Please wait for this panda's answer first before you invite somebody else.
snippets.GAME_INVITATION_INFO_04: $$username$$ invites you to play $$gamename$$. Do you want to accept this invitation and play a round of $$gamename$$?
